question: Find the area of a parallelogram whose adjacent sides are determined by the vectors $\vec{a}=\hat{i}-\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-7\hat{j}+\hat{k}$.
explanation:
**Step 1:** The area of a parallelogram is given by $|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|$. Compute $\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \left|\begin{matrix}\hat{i}&\hat{j}&\hat{k}\\ 1&-1&3\\ 2&-7&1\end{matrix}\right| = \hat{i}(-1+21) - \hat{j}(1-6) + \hat{k}(-7+2) = 20\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}$.
**Step 2:** Find the magnitude: $|20\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}| = \sqrt{20^2 + 5^2 + (-5)^2} = \sqrt{400 + 25 + 25} = \sqrt{450} = 15\sqrt{2}\text{ sq. units}$.
